issues.description: The template class GroverTwoQubitWithoutAuxiliaryQubit.__init__ declares a parameter (num_qubits: int) but does not use it, while the solution's constructor has no parameter. This mismatch is structural: students following the template will implement a constructor that expects an argument, yet the problem examples / solution instantiate the class without arguments. This can lead to confusion and runtime errors when running the provided solution/run examples or tests that instantiate the class without parameters.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template constructor match the intended usage: remove the unused parameter so __init__(self) is used (as in the solution), or else update the solution and problem examples to instantiate with the parameter and document its purpose. Prefer removing the unused num_qubits parameter from the template and setting the query-register size internally (e.g., number_of_qubits_query_register = 2) to align template, solution, and problem text.
